# Elmer Quispe-Salazar

**Marine Quantitative Ecologist & Fisheries Scientist**

I work at the intersection of quantitative marine ecology, fisheries science, marine data science, and decision science. My work focuses on pelagic fish and marine ecosystems, combining stock assessment, spatio-temporal modelling, population and life-history processes, environmental variability, multidimensional indicators, and reproducible scientific computing.

[Open complete CV (PDF)](/files/CV.pdf){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9229-6379){.btn} [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=wz83egoAAAAJ&hl=en){.btn} [GitHub](https://github.com/qselmer){.btn}

## Research focus

- quantitative marine ecology, fisheries science, and stock assessment;
- population and community dynamics, recruitment, growth, and life-history variation;
- spatio-temporal modelling, statistical ecology, and marine ecosystem indicators;
- pelagic fish and ecosystem dynamics in the Humboldt Current and other Eastern Boundary Upwelling Systems;
- multidimensional stock-state diagnostics, thresholds, regime shifts, and pressure–state relationships;
- integration of biological, fishery, and environmental evidence for adaptive management;
- reproducible scientific workflows in R, Python, C++, Julia, Git, and GitHub.
